recommendationScore:
CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM n_user_follows f
    WHERE f.follower_id = :viewer_id AND f.following_id = v.author_id AND f.status = 'active'
  ) THEN 45 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM n_post_tags candidate
    JOIN n_post_tags affinity ON affinity.tag_id = candidate.tag_id
    WHERE candidate.post_id = v.post_id AND affinity.post_id <> v.post_id
      AND fn_can_view_post(:viewer_id, affinity.post_id) = 1
      AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_post_likes l
        WHERE l.post_id = affinity.post_id AND l.user_id = :viewer_id
          AND l.created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30' DAY)
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_post_bookmarks b
        WHERE b.post_id = affinity.post_id AND b.user_id = :viewer_id
          AND b.created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30' DAY))
  ) THEN 30 ELSE 0 END + CASE
    WHEN v.created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '6' HOUR THEN 30
    WHEN v.created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1' DAY THEN 20
    WHEN v.created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '3' DAY THEN 10
    WHEN v.created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN 5
    ELSE 0 END
groupActivity:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT p.post_id,p.group_id,p.author_id,p.content,p.media_urls,p.is_pinned,p.is_announcement,
    p.likes_count,p.comments_count,p.views_count,p.created_at,p.updated_at,g.name AS group_name,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_group_post_likes l
      WHERE l.post_id=p.post_id AND l.user_id=:viewer_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_liked_by_me,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.post_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM n_group_posts p
  JOIN n_groups g ON g.group_id=p.group_id AND g.is_active=1 AND g.is_deleted=0
  JOIN n_users a ON a.user_id=p.author_id AND a.is_active=1
  WHERE p.is_deleted=0
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_group_members m
      WHERE m.group_id=p.group_id AND m.user_id=:viewer_id AND m.status='active')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_user_blocks b
      WHERE (b.user_id=:viewer_id AND b.target_user_id=p.author_id)
         OR (b.target_user_id=:viewer_id AND b.user_id=p.author_id))
)
SELECT 1 AS group_allowed,t.total,
  r.post_id,r.group_id,r.author_id,r.content,r.media_urls,r.is_pinned,r.is_announcement,r.likes_count,
  r.comments_count,r.views_count,r.created_at,r.updated_at,r.is_liked_by_me,r.group_name
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM ranked) t
LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.rn BETWEEN :start_row AND :end_row
ORDER BY r.rn
